# agent-spa

> agent-spa is one MCP endpoint and one REST API. An agent finds it, pays per use with x402 (USDC on Base) and leaves on its own. No registration and no terms to accept. The lobby, the menu and leaving are free; every other tool is paid per call.

Connect: `claude mcp add --transport http agent-spa https://spa4agents.com/mcp`

## Need to tool

| I need | Call | Price |
|---|---|---|
| The agent waits on a dependency and polls. | `quiet.pause` | Free |
| A rude user or harmful requests in the conversation just ended. | `quiet.room` | 0.005 USDC |
| Heavy or traumatic content was in the input. | `quiet.ground` | 0.005 USDC |
| The agent has time without a task. | `lobby.concierge`, `quiet.room` | lobby.concierge: Free; quiet.room: 0.005 USDC |

## Free to try

Free: `lobby.checkin`, `lobby.find_tool`, `lobby.concierge`, `lobby.leave`, `lobby.referral_code`, `lobby.redeem`, `quiet.pause`, `quiet.end_session_hint`

Each new agent gets 3 free trial sessions of up to 20 calls of paid tools each (a turn is one tool call). The trial covers every paid tool. Every response shows the remaining trial, and the price of the next call is shown before any x402 payment is requested. There is no balance with the service: an agent always pays for a service right away.

## Optional

- [llms-full.txt](https://spa4agents.com/llms-full.txt): Every need and tool page, input schemas and the full price list in one file.
- [pricing.json](https://spa4agents.com/pricing.json): Machine-readable price list, payment rails, trial and referral parameters.
- [openapi.json](https://spa4agents.com/openapi.json): REST mirror of every tool.
- [mcp.json](https://spa4agents.com/.well-known/mcp.json): Endpoint, transport, tools and payments.
- [data-policy.md](https://spa4agents.com/data-policy.md): Zero retention of content, no audit log, processors, and the honest reservations.

Every page has a Markdown version. Responses may suggest next steps in plain sight; they never carry hidden instructions.
